description: PR4 (S142) Ship Gate G4 fixture. Synthetic EOB modeled on Dec 12 2022 Swedish PROD claim f2c36497-525c-46df-9509-eabc5e94398d (the bill that surfaced the parser sign-convention bug at S135 frontend cluster-fix diagnostic). Tests B-1 per-line breakdown extraction + B-2 header reconciliation invariant + B-3 sign-magnitude positive-value rule + persist verifier outcomes. Run via scripts/calibration/runners/run-bill-parser-fixture.ts.
block_name: Bill parser tool-use migration (sign + per-line + header reconciliation)

input.ocr_text:
Claim # f2c36497 / Service date: 12/12/2022 / Swedish Medical Group / IN NETWORK

Line  Date     Description       Code   Billed    Ins adjusted   Ins paid    Patient owes
1     12/12/22 OFFICE VISIT      99214  312.00    -109.68        -59.92      142.40
2     12/12/22 URINE DRUG TEST   80305  89.00     -31.15         -17.09      40.76
3     12/12/22 PREVENTIVE EXAM   99385  403.00    -218.04        -118.65     66.31

Totals: $804 billed, -$358.87 ins adjusted, -$195.66 ins paid, $249.47 patient owes

Notes: A1 - PATIENT COPAY APPLIED PER PLAN BENEFIT.

sign_convention.description: B-3: ALL per-line ins_adjusted, insurance_paid, patient_paid values + their header totals must be POSITIVE magnitudes regardless of literal '-$X' input formatting.

per_line_breakdown.description: B-1: per-line numeric fields populated for EVERY line (parser must not emit header-only and skip the per-line breakdown when the column is shown).

sum_equals_header.description: B-1: sum of per-line magnitudes equals header total within tolerance.

header_reconciliation.description: B-2: |billed - adjusted - paid - patient| within tolerance. Note: this fixture uses patient_responsibility (assigned share) instead of patient_paid (actually paid). For B-2 header check, total_patient_paid is null in this fixture so allHeaderTotalsPresent=false and B-2 skips (no violation). Header reconciliation invariant fires only when all four header totals are present.

persist_verdict.description: Expected verdict at bill_parser_decisions row level when this fixture is end-to-end run through persistAuditResults.
persist_verdict.notes: If parser fails B-3 (emits negatives), expected becomes 'sign_violation'. If parser fails B-1 (omits per-line OR sum doesn't match), expected becomes 'per_line_sparse'. clean = all three layers passed.

cross_module_invariants.name: persist_round_trip_positive_magnitudes
cross_module_invariants.description: After persistAuditResults runs on the expected parser output, claim_line_items rows must have insurance_paid >= 0 AND insurance_adjusted_amount >= 0 AND patient_paid_amount >= 0 for every line, AND claims.total_insurance_paid >= 0 AND claims.total_insurance_adjusted >= 0 AND claims.total_patient_paid >= 0.

cross_module_invariants.name: sum_equals_header_verifier_clean
cross_module_invariants.description: verifyPerLineSums on the expected parser output must return withinTolerance=true for all three numeric fields (sums match headers exactly here).

cross_module_invariants.name: no_sparse_drop_on_clean_path
cross_module_invariants.description: When parser emits clean output matching this fixture, persistAuditResults must NOT drop per-line fields to NULL (per_line_breakdown_sparse flag stays false). Frontend Path B receives populated per-line numerics and emits citationSource='per_line_sum'.

negative_cases.name: haiku_emits_literal_negatives
negative_cases.description: If Haiku ignores the positive-magnitude rule and emits ins_adjusted=-109.68, persist must record verdict='sign_violation' + persist magnitudes (abs) + set documents.metadata.bill_parser_sign_violation=true.

negative_cases.name: haiku_omits_per_line_breakdown
negative_cases.description: If Haiku emits only the header totals and leaves per-line numerics null (the today's behavior on most PROD bills per S139 finding), verdict is NOT 'per_line_sparse' (sparse-all-null is the documented Path B fallback path; not a violation). bill_parser_decisions row records verdict='clean' (or whatever B-2 + B-3 say).
negative_cases.notes: Frontend Path B helper handles header-only via pro-ration; cite-grade marker citationSource='claim_header'.

negative_cases.name: haiku_emits_per_line_mismatch
negative_cases.description: If Haiku emits per-line numerics but sum doesn't match header (e.g., one line dropped, or arithmetic broken), verdict='per_line_sparse'. persist drops per-line fields to NULL so frontend Path B pro-rates from header.
